description_expanded:
This beautiful 3-bedroom vacation rental is inside the newest building at Alys Beach and is the perfect location to enjoy all town amenities. Located on the third floor of the Whitby building, this condo offers three bedrooms and three full baths. The open-concept great room offers plenty of natural light and combines a galley-style kitchen with center island, the dining area seating six and the family room offering ample seating. A spacious balcony overlooks the Town Center and the Amphitheatre. The primary suite offers a king-sized bed and private bath. The second and third bedrooms each offer a queen-sized bed. Parking for this condo consist of one designated space in a parking court behind The Whitby. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Whitby 304. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
